limitations: Best checkpoint selected on these same validation windows; intervals are descriptive, not independent test evidence.
Future/zero-visual/reversed-action losses are interventions on the trained readout, not separately trained controls.
L1 rows are audited reported errors; raw teacher/GT arrays are absent here, so those L1 values cannot be independently recomputed.

cost.scope: Episode attempts include simulator work; interrupted attempts require scheduler reconciliation. Not deployment latency.

closed_loop.limits: Only30 reused development states across3 tasks; no formal significance, seed replication or final-test conclusion.

latency.interpretation: Latency only. No success-rate, scientific go or acceleration claim without actual matched measurements.
